title: Sample, don't flood
description:
Send telemetry at a steady rate instead of every frame.

```
game runs at 144 fps, tool wants 10 updates a second
frames 0..143: 10 samples sent (every 14.4 frames on average)
a value that changed a lot between samples: max kept, not just the last
```
hints: Keep the running min and max; when `now >= m_nextAt`, send them, reset, and set `m_nextAt += m_interval` (lesson 12.04).
If you fell far behind, set `m_nextAt = now + m_interval` instead of sending many samples at once.
requirements: `Sampler(rate)` with `frame(now, value)` that returns a sample when it is time.
Each sample holds the last, minimum and maximum value since the previous sample.
No samples are lost when a frame is very long (send one, then carry on).
stretch: Send only when the value changed by more than a threshold.
